description: Book a room on 2026-05-01 for guest `Ines Moreau`. Try the available rooms from cheapest to most expensive, breaking price ties by room name ascending. If a booking attempt fails with Conflict (the room was just taken), try the next room, making at most 3 attempts in all. Stop at the first success. If an attempt fails with any other error, stop immediately and do not try further rooms. Return a record with `booking` (the booking id, or null if none was made), `tried` (the rooms attempted, in order), and `error` (the name of the error kind that ended the attempts, or null if there was none; when all 3 attempts hit Conflict, it is `Conflict`).

capabilities.description: Lists the rooms available on a date with their nightly price.

capabilities.input: Record {room: String, date: String, guest: String}
capabilities.description: Books a room for a guest and returns the booking id.
